name: Mystereet ~Detective Vacation~
original_name: ミステリート ～ディテクティブ・バケーション～
source:
Fandisc includes two stories:

1. Episode 5. The scent of killer in the guest house.『民宿は殺し屋の香り』
Detective office goes on a vacation with whole cast to old detective acquaintances in the port town. But their stay gets interrupted by rumors of a European assassin called "Windmaster" who seems to be currently at this town as well.

2. Episode 3 1/2. Trap girl with bitter memories debut『女装デビューはホロ苦い思い出』
Hikawa Mai stays at the detective office for a week before invitation arrives. She is always busy preparing tea. This time she also brings apple pie as tea is not enough for this talk. She tells a story about past when Kaoru was still class B detective and was chased by mafia.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-may-2006-hidamari.html]vndbreview[/url]]
